text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Woooo! The great northern gods
granted me
their protection, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the Sapporo Kinen is in
the books!
Wanna go sightseeing to
celebrate?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru and I are walking by
the
famous Sapporo Clock Tower,
when...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Look at the clock's needle,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's pointing directly south. Do you think
it's a
sign?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What racecourse is straight south of
here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking into account upcoming races,
Nakayama
Racecourse in Chiba
Prefecture comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That gives me an idea for our next race.
I'd like to
run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It was only the compassion from my
devoted fans
that got me a spot in the
Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But this time, I want to actually earn all
those
votes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's take all these wishes we've
gathered and
bring them to Nakayama
at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Do you mean it? Thank you so much!
choice_data_list_en: ...Got it. Let's go with the Arima.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
They say Umamusume who do well in the
Sapporo
Kinen have what it takes to
face the Arima Kinen.
So let's keep it up!
